name: 診断情報を添付する選択カード
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0045 診断情報を添付する選択カード.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: original-card-readable-detail. Image 3: secondary-component-preview. Image 4: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Use case: ui-mockup. Only LH07-0045 compact selected screenshot-attachment card. Target358x60 CSS-like proportions, border1px neutral gray, corner6px, white ordinary surface, padding8px, tight10px gaps. No second outer card or large whitespace. Original source and supplied original card crop are PRIMARY, especially screenshot thumbnail artwork/crop, circle/check glyph anatomy and alignment. Left20px selected circle with white tick shaped exactly as original; forest gradient#174C36->#1F6444->#2D8F5E replaces original blue selection. Center two exact Japanese strings, both Regular: スクリーンショット (Meiryo14/24, charcoal) then 情報を隠す・強調する (Meiryo12/16,forestgreen). Do not bold either line. Right actual screenshot thumbnail around70x52, aligned toward rightedge, retaining source photo/feed and partial small share menu in SAME crop and colors. Do not replace artwork with invented mountains, generic image icon or text. Do not add参考画像 caption (stale native placeholder absent from final mock and original). No new badges, chevrons, text, buttons or other rows. Compact but legible, no enlargedtypography, no offwhite/green background, no shadow. Match supplied original art with minimal rendering differences. Use uniform enlarged inspection scale if needed, but content proportions must describe a normal compact card and crop close around the component.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Convert selected circle to official forest gradient and action text forest green. Preserve all screenshot thumbnail colors/artwork and white check; ordinary card surface pure white, border subtle neutral.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION, 2026-10-18: previous candidates were too big and too spacious. This overrides earlier source-spacing and presentation-enlargement instructions. Use compact ordinary UI proportions, content-driven control widths, restrained small radii, tight but readable padding, and little outer presentation whitespace. Preserve exact established Japanese font roles; do not shrink text to manufacture density. Preserve original icon geometry, strokes, states and artwork. Avoid stretching a small standalone utility control across an entire screen. Use the owner-corrected180x28 three-segment control as a density reference only, not a size to force onto unrelated components. Output image pixels are inspection resolution, never intended application CSS size.
reviewNotes: 文言と元スクリーンショット内容は概ね保持。カードは幅358換算で約69px高く、目標60pxより余白が多い。選択丸も約28pxで目標20pxを超える。サムネイルに不要な独立枠/丸みが追加。密度と見本の枠だけ限定修正する。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
